test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Powada dance' is a performing art from the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

__
 
• **Powada is the traditional folk art from Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Powada **itself means “the narration of a story in glorious terms”.

 
 
• Th e narratives are always odes in praise of an individual hero or an incident or place.
 
• The chief narrator is known as the Shahir who plays the duff to keep the rhythm.
 
• The tempo is fast and controlled by the main singer who is supported by others in the chorus.
 
• The earli est notable Powada was the Afzal Khanacha Vadh (The Killing of Afzal Khan) (1659) by Agnidas which recorded Shivaji’s encounter with Afzal Khan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **List of folk dances of different states in India:**

 
 
• **Gujarat **- Garba, Dandiya Ras, Tippani Juriun, Bhavai.
 
• **Rajasthan **- Ghumar, Chakri, Ganagaur, Jhulan Leela, Jhuma, Suisini, Ghapal, Kalbeliya.
 
• **Kerala **- Kathakali (Classical), Ottam Thulal, Mohiniattam, Kaikottikali.
 
• **Maharashtra **- Lavani, Nakata, Koli, Lezim, Gafa, Dahikala Dasavtar or Bohada.
